profile_text.body:
Procare Solutions describes itself as a leader in child care management software, saying its product simplifies child care program operations so staff can focus on the children. The company says its data model is based on experience working with over 100,000 child care centers, before and after school programs and youth. It also runs an annual survey of early education, which this year focuses on AI and how it is reshaping early childhood education and leadership, with respondents entered to win 1 of 6 Apple iPads.

The company's tracked product is Procare, listed under education and research AI and used for child care management by early childhood programs and families. The listing notes that its AI features have not been verified and that it was found during research for The AI Ready School rather than independently confirmed. Pricing is quote-based, and the listing cautions that one competitor reports plans from $69/month, a competitor source to treat cautiously.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent facts are recorded for the company.
